# Bitcoin Research Kit (BRK) — Full API Reference

> Generated from BRK's OpenAPI specification and metric tree. Do not edit this file manually.

- Version: `v0.12.2`
- Base URL: https://bitview.space
- MCP endpoint: https://mcp.bitview.space/
- Metrics: 21009
- Operations: 99

For machine-readable tool construction, use [https://bitview.space/openapi.json](https://bitview.space/openapi.json). For the complete source-derived series tree, use [https://bitview.space/api/series](https://bitview.space/api/series).

## Operations

### Address

#### GET `/api/address/hash-prefix/{address_type}/{prefix}`

Address hash-prefix matches

Find addresses by address type and by the first 1-16 hex nibbles of RapidHash v3 over the raw address payload bytes. Intended for privacy-preserving client-side wallet discovery without sending raw addresses or xpubs. Fetch metadata with `GET /api/address/{address}`.

Parameters:
- `address_type` (path, OutputType, required)
- `prefix` (path, string, required): First 1–16 hexadecimal nibbles of the RapidHash v3 hash over the raw address payload bytes.

Returns: JSON `AddressHashPrefixMatches`

#### GET `/api/address/{address}`

Address information

Balance and transaction counts. Supports P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, P2TR and P2A addresses, and P2PK public keys in hex (33 or 65 bytes). *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address)*

Parameters:
- `address` (path, Address, required)

Returns: JSON `AddressStats`

#### GET `/api/address/{address}/txs`

Address transactions

Get transaction history for an address, newest first. Returns up to 50 mempool transactions plus a confirmed page sized to fill the response to 50 total (chain floor of 25, so 25-50 confirmed depending on mempool weight). To paginate further confirmed history, request `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}` with the last returned txid. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions)*

Parameters:
- `address` (path, Address, required)

Returns: JSON `Transaction[]`

#### GET `/api/address/{address}/txs/chain`

Address confirmed transactions

Get the first 25 confirmed transactions for an address. For pagination, request `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}` with the last returned txid. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions-chain)*

Parameters:
- `address` (path, Address, required)

Returns: JSON `Transaction[]`

#### GET `/api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}`

Address confirmed transactions (paginated)

Get the next 25 confirmed transactions strictly older than `after_txid` (Esplora-canonical pagination form, matches mempool.space). *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions-chain)*

Parameters:
- `address` (path, Address, required)
- `after_txid` (path, Txid, required): Last txid from the previous page (return transactions strictly older than this)

Returns: JSON `Transaction[]`

#### GET `/api/address/{address}/txs/mempool`

Address mempool transactions

Get unconfirmed transactions for an address from the mempool, newest first (up to 50). *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions-mempool)*

Parameters:
- `address` (path, Address, required)

Returns: JSON `Transaction[]`

#### GET `/api/address/{address}/utxo`

Address UTXOs

Get unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) for an address, including unconfirmed ones; outputs that mempool transactions spend are left out. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-utxo)*

Parameters:
- `address` (path, Address, required)

Returns: JSON `Utxo[]`

### Api.json

#### GET `/api.json`

Compact API summary

Compact custom summary of the OpenAPI specification for LLM reading: types instead of schemas, `returns` instead of responses, no examples; parameters keep their enum, default and bounds. Not valid OpenAPI: build tools from `GET /openapi.json`.

Returns: JSON `value`

### Block

#### GET `/api/block/{hash}`

Block information

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block)*

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, BlockHash, required)

Returns: JSON `BlockInfo`

#### GET `/api/block/{hash}/header`

Block header

Returns the hex-encoded 80-byte block header. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-header)*

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, BlockHash, required)

Returns: text `Hex`

#### GET `/api/block/{hash}/raw`

Raw block

Returns the raw block data in binary format. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-raw)*

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, BlockHash, required)

Returns: binary data

#### GET `/api/block/{hash}/status`

Block status

Whether the block is in the best chain and, if so, its height and the hash of the next block. A block outside the best chain (orphaned or unknown) reports `in_best_chain: false`. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-status)*

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, BlockHash, required)

Returns: JSON `BlockStatus`

#### GET `/api/block/{hash}/txid/{index}`

Transaction ID at index

Retrieve a single transaction ID at a specific index within a block. Returns plain text txid. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-transaction-id)*

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, BlockHash, required)
- `index` (path, BlockTxIndex, required): Transaction index within the block (0-based)

Returns: text `Txid`

#### GET `/api/block/{hash}/txids`

Block transaction IDs

Transaction IDs in block order. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-transaction-ids)*

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, BlockHash, required)

Returns: JSON `Txid[]`

#### GET `/api/block/{hash}/txs`

Block transactions

Up to 25 transactions starting at index 0. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-transactions)*

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, BlockHash, required)

Returns: JSON `Transaction[]`

#### GET `/api/block/{hash}/txs/{start_index}`

Block transactions (paginated)

Up to 25 transactions starting at `start_index`. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-transactions)*

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, BlockHash, required)
- `start_index` (path, BlockTxIndex, required): Starting transaction index within the block (0-based)

Returns: JSON `Transaction[]`

#### GET `/api/v1/block/{hash}`

Block (v1)

Returns block details with extras by hash. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-v1)*

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, BlockHash, required)

Returns: JSON `BlockInfoV1`

### Blocks

#### GET `/api/blocks`

Recent blocks

The last 10 blocks. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks)*

Returns: JSON `BlockInfo[]`

#### GET `/api/blocks/tip/hash`

Block tip hash

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-tip-hash)*

Returns: text `BlockHash`

#### GET `/api/blocks/tip/height`

Block tip height

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-tip-height)*

Returns: text `Height`

#### GET `/api/blocks/{height}`

Blocks from height

Retrieve up to 10 blocks going backwards from the given height. For example, height=100 returns blocks 100, 99, 98, ..., 91. Height=0 returns only block 0. A height past the tip is not found. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks)*

Parameters:
- `height` (path, Height, required)

Returns: JSON `BlockInfo[]`

#### GET `/api/v1/blocks`

Recent blocks with extras

Retrieve the last 15 blocks with extended data including pool identification and fee statistics. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks-v1)*

Returns: JSON `BlockInfoV1[]`

#### GET `/api/v1/blocks/{height}`

Blocks from height with extras

Retrieve up to 15 blocks with extended data going backwards from the given height: the published blocks among the 15 heights ending at it, so fewer (or none) past the tip. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks-v1)*

Parameters:
- `height` (path, Height, required)

Returns: JSON `BlockInfoV1[]`

### Cpfp

#### GET `/api/v1/cpfp/{txid}`

CPFP info

Returns ancestors and descendants for a CPFP (Child Pays For Parent) transaction, including the effective fee rate of the package. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-children-pay-for-parent)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)

Returns: JSON `CpfpInfo`

### Difficulty Adjustment

Difficulty adjustment

Get current difficulty adjustment progress and estimates. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-difficulty-adjustment)*

Returns: JSON `DifficultyAdjustment`

### Fees

#### GET `/api/v1/fees/mempool-blocks`

Projected mempool blocks

Projected blocks for fee estimation. Block 0 reflects Bitcoin Core's actual next-block selection; blocks 1+ are a fee-tier approximation. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool-blocks-fees)*

Returns: JSON `MempoolBlock[]`

#### GET `/api/v1/fees/precise`

Recommended fee rates (precise)

Recommended fee rates by confirmation target, with up to three decimal places and support for sub-sat/vB rates. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-recommended-fees-precise)*

Returns: JSON `PreciseRecommendedFees`

#### GET `/api/v1/fees/recommended`

Recommended fees

Recommended fee rates by confirmation target, in whole sat/vB. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-recommended-fees)*

Returns: JSON `RecommendedFees`

### Fullrbf

#### GET `/api/v1/fullrbf/replacements`

Recent full-RBF replacements

Same response shape as `GET /api/v1/replacements`, but limited to trees where at least one predecessor was non-signaling (full-RBF). *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-fullrbf-replacements)*

Returns: JSON `ReplacementNode[]`

### Health

#### GET `/health`

Health check

Local health and query-readiness check. Returns server identity, uptime, and a coherent local sync snapshot without a bitcoind round-trip. Reads the published prefix during processing; an empty index returns 503 `state_updating` at once. Responses are not cached. For chain-tip catch-up, request `GET /api/server/sync`.

Returns: JSON `Health`

### Historical Price

#### GET `/api/v1/historical-price`

Historical price

Completed four-hour BTC/USD closes, oldest first, labeled by interval end, from the first priced interval (2010-08-16). With a UNIX timestamp, returns the latest nonempty completed close at or before it; before the first close returns an empty list. The current partial interval is excluded. USD only (`currency` accepts `USD`); exchangeRates is empty. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-historical-price)*

Parameters:
- `timestamp` (query, Timestamp, optional): UNIX timestamp: the latest close at or before it
- `currency` (query, Currency, optional): Quote currency: USD, the only one served

Returns: JSON `HistoricalPrice`

### Mempool

#### GET `/api/mempool`

Mempool statistics

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool)*

Returns: JSON `MempoolInfo`

#### GET `/api/mempool/hash`

Mempool content hash

Returns an opaque content token for the published projected next block, including statistics and transaction bodies. This is not the HTTP ETag. An unchanged token means unchanged content, not necessarily a stalled sync loop.

Returns: JSON `NextBlockHash`

#### GET `/api/mempool/price`

Live BTC/USD price

Current BTC/USD price in dollars, derived from on-chain round-dollar output patterns in the oracle's recent-block window, with the mempool's outputs blended in when available.

Returns: JSON `Dollars`

#### GET `/api/mempool/recent`

Recent mempool transactions

Get the last 10 transactions to enter the mempool. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool-recent)*

Returns: JSON `MempoolRecentTx[]`

#### GET `/api/mempool/txids`

Mempool transaction IDs

Get all transaction IDs currently in the mempool. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool-transaction-ids)*

Returns: JSON `Txid[]`

#### GET `/api/v1/mempool/block-template`

Projected next block template

Bitcoin Core's `getblocktemplate` selection: full transaction bodies in GBT order with aggregate stats. The returned `hash` is an opaque content token; pass it to `GET /api/v1/mempool/block-template/diff/{hash}` to fetch deltas instead of refetching the whole template.

Returns: JSON `BlockTemplate`

#### GET `/api/v1/mempool/block-template/diff/{hash}`

Block template diff since hash

Delta of the projected next block since `<hash>`. `order` is the full new template in order: each entry is either a number (index into the prior template the client cached at `<hash>`) or a transaction object (new body to insert at this position). Walk `order` once to rebuild and replace the cached `stats` with the response's; `removed` is a convenience list of txids that left so clients can evict cached bodies. After applying, use the response `hash` as `<hash>` on the next call to keep iterating. Returns `404` when `<hash>` has aged out of server history; clients should fall back to `GET /api/v1/mempool/block-template`.

Parameters:
- `hash` (path, NextBlockHash, required)

Returns: JSON `BlockTemplateDiff`

### Mining

#### GET `/api/v1/mining/blocks/fee-rates/{time_period}`

Block fee rates

Get block fee rate percentiles (min, 10th, 25th, median, 75th, 90th, max) for a time period. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-feerates)*

Parameters:
- `time_period` (path, TimePeriod, required): Lookback period: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y` or `all`.

Returns: JSON `BlockFeeRatesEntry[]`

#### GET `/api/v1/mining/blocks/fees/{time_period}`

Block fees

Get average total fees per block for a time period. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-fees)*

Parameters:
- `time_period` (path, TimePeriod, required): Lookback period: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y` or `all`.

Returns: JSON `BlockFeesEntry[]`

#### GET `/api/v1/mining/blocks/rewards/{time_period}`

Block rewards

Get average coinbase reward (subsidy + fees) per block for a time period. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-rewards)*

Parameters:
- `time_period` (path, TimePeriod, required): Lookback period: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y` or `all`.

Returns: JSON `BlockRewardsEntry[]`

#### GET `/api/v1/mining/blocks/sizes-weights/{time_period}`

Block sizes and weights

Get average block sizes and weights for a time period. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-sizes-weights)*

Parameters:
- `time_period` (path, TimePeriod, required): Lookback period: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y` or `all`.

Returns: JSON `BlockSizesWeights`

#### GET `/api/v1/mining/blocks/timestamp/{timestamp}`

Block by timestamp

Find the block with the greatest header timestamp at or before the given UNIX timestamp, choosing the earliest height on ties. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-timestamp)*

Parameters:
- `timestamp` (path, Timestamp, required)

Returns: JSON `BlockTimestamp`

#### GET `/api/v1/mining/difficulty-adjustments`

Difficulty adjustments (all time)

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-difficulty-adjustments)*

#### GET `/api/v1/mining/difficulty-adjustments/{time_period}`

### Openapi.json

OpenAPI specification

Full OpenAPI 3.1 specification for this API. Build tools from this document.

Returns: JSON `value`

### Oracle

#### GET `/api/oracle/histogram/outputs/live`

Live output value histogram

Live unfiltered output value histogram for the complete published mempool. Nonzero outputs within the histogram's bin range are counted by value on the oracle log scale; no oracle payment filters are applied. A flat array of log-scale bins, all zero when no mempool is configured.

Returns: JSON `integer[]`

#### GET `/api/oracle/histogram/outputs/{point}`

Output value histogram at height or day

Unfiltered output value histogram for a confirmed point. A block height (`840000`) counts that block's nonzero outputs within the histogram's bin range, coinbase included, by value on the oracle log scale; a calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) sums every block that day. A flat array of log-scale bins.

Parameters:
- `point` (path, string, required): Confirmed block height as decimal digits (`840000`) or calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

Returns: JSON `integer[]`

#### GET `/api/oracle/histogram/payments/live`

Live payment output histogram

Live smoothed histogram of oracle-eligible payment outputs, binned by output value on the oracle log scale. It combines the committed oracle window with the complete mempool's eligible outputs from a matching chain publication. A flat array of log-scale bins.

Returns: JSON `integer[]`

#### GET `/api/oracle/histogram/payments/{point}`

Payment output histogram at height or day

Smoothed histogram of oracle-eligible payment outputs for a confirmed point. A block height (`840000`) gives that block's oracle payment histogram; a calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) gives the average of that day's per-block payment histograms. A flat array of log-scale bins.

Parameters:
- `point` (path, string, required): Confirmed block height as decimal digits (`840000`) or calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

Returns: JSON `integer[]`

#### GET `/api/oracle/price`

Live BTC/USD price

Current BTC/USD price in dollars. Same value as `GET /api/mempool/price`. Confirmed per-height history is available at `GET /api/series/price/height`.

Returns: JSON `Dollars`

### Prices

#### GET `/api/v1/prices`

Current BTC price

Returns bitcoin latest price (on-chain derived, USD only). *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-price)*

Returns: JSON `PricePoint`

### Replacements

#### GET `/api/v1/replacements`

Recent RBF replacements

Returns up to 25 most-recent RBF replacement trees across the whole mempool. Each entry has the shape of `replacements` in `GET /api/v1/tx/{txid}/rbf`. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-replacements)*

Returns: JSON `ReplacementNode[]`

### Series

#### GET `/api/series`

Series catalog

The available series as a tree of categories and subcategories.

Returns: JSON `TreeNode`

#### GET `/api/series/bulk`

Bulk series data

Fetch multiple series in a single request. Supports filtering by index and date range. Returns an array of SeriesData objects. For a single series, use `get_series` instead.

Parameters:
- `series` (query, SeriesList, required)
- `index` (query, Index, required)
- `start` (query, RangeIndex, optional): Inclusive start: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. REST aliases: `from`, `f`, `s`
- `end` (query, RangeIndex, optional): Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. REST aliases: `to`, `t`, `e`
- `limit` (query, Limit, optional): Maximum number of values to return (ignored if `end` is set); omitted, the rest of the range. REST aliases: `count`, `c`, `l`
- `format` (query, Format, optional)

Returns: JSON `SeriesData[]`

#### GET `/api/series/count`

Series count

Returns the number of series available per index type.

Returns: JSON `DetailedSeriesCount`

#### GET `/api/series/indexes`

List available indexes

Returns all available indexes with their accepted REST query aliases. REST series queries accept any alias; MCP tools take the canonical `index` name only.

Returns: JSON `IndexInfo[]`

#### GET `/api/series/list`

Series list

Paginated flat list of all available series names.

Parameters:
- `page` (query, integer, optional): Zero-based page number (default: 0)
- `per_page` (query, integer, optional): Results per page (default: 1000, max: 1000)

Returns: JSON `PaginatedSeries`

#### GET `/api/series/search`

Search series

Search series by name or descriptive terms. Results prioritize whole query words in names, then descriptions, then fuzzy names, then fuzzy descriptions. Word order does not matter. Descriptions provide cohort terminology and formulas. The decoded q parameter is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

Parameters:
- `q` (query, SeriesName, required): Search query string
- `limit` (query, Limit, optional): Maximum number of results, 100 when omitted

Returns: JSON `string[]`

#### GET `/api/series/{series}`

Get series info

Returns the optional description, supported indexes, the indexes whose values can be null, the value type, and the optional unit (what the value type measures) for the specified series. The decoded series name is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

Parameters:
- `series` (path, SeriesName, required)

Returns: JSON `SeriesInfo`

#### GET `/api/series/{series}/{index}`

Get series data

Rows selected by a range of positions, dates or timestamps, as JSON or CSV.

Parameters:
- `series` (path, SeriesName, required)
- `index` (path, Index, required)
- `start` (query, RangeIndex, optional): Inclusive start: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. REST aliases: `from`, `f`, `s`
- `end` (query, RangeIndex, optional): Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. REST aliases: `to`, `t`, `e`
- `limit` (query, Limit, optional): Maximum number of values to return (ignored if `end` is set); omitted, the rest of the range. REST aliases: `count`, `c`, `l`
- `format` (query, Format, optional)

Returns: JSON `SeriesData`

#### GET `/api/series/{series}/{index}/data`

Get raw series data

The data array without the `SeriesData` wrapper. Supports the same range and format parameters as `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}`.

Parameters:
- `series` (path, SeriesName, required)
- `index` (path, Index, required)
- `start` (query, RangeIndex, optional): Inclusive start: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. REST aliases: `from`, `f`, `s`
- `end` (query, RangeIndex, optional): Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. REST aliases: `to`, `t`, `e`
- `limit` (query, Limit, optional): Maximum number of values to return (ignored if `end` is set); omitted, the rest of the range. REST aliases: `count`, `c`, `l`
- `format` (query, Format, optional)

Returns: JSON `value[]`

#### GET `/api/series/{series}/{index}/latest`

Get latest series value

Returns the single most recent value for a series, unwrapped (not inside a SeriesData object).

Parameters:
- `series` (path, SeriesName, required)
- `index` (path, Index, required)

Returns: JSON `value`

#### GET `/api/series/{series}/{index}/len`

Get series data length

Parameters:
- `series` (path, SeriesName, required)
- `index` (path, Index, required)

Returns: JSON `integer`

#### GET `/api/series/{series}/{index}/version`

Get series version

Returns the vector's schema/computation version, not its length or latest update. Appends and reorgs do not by themselves change this version.

Parameters:
- `series` (path, SeriesName, required)
- `index` (path, Index, required)

Returns: JSON `Version`

### Server

#### GET `/api/server/disk`

Disk usage

Returns allocated file bytes (file lengths on non-Unix platforms) for BRK and Bitcoin data. Each request scans both trees; these are independent observations, not an atomic filesystem snapshot. Conditional requests validate the newly observed totals. Directory-link cycles and excessive nesting fail without returning partial totals.

Returns: JSON `DiskUsage`

#### GET `/api/server/sync`

Sync status

Returns a coherent local index snapshot and a separately observed Bitcoin Core tip height. The two heights can differ during indexing or a reorg. Conditional requests refresh these observations before validation.

Returns: JSON `SyncStatus`

### Transaction Times

#### GET `/api/v1/transaction-times`

Transaction first-seen times

First-seen UNIX timestamps in seconds, in request order, of transactions in the mempool or that recently left it other than by replacement (mined ones included); 0 otherwise. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-times)*

Parameters:
- `txId[]` (query, Txid[], required): Transaction IDs to look up (max 250 per request).

Returns: JSON `integer[]`

### Tx

#### POST `/api/tx`

Broadcast transaction

Submit a raw transaction as hexadecimal text (at most 8,000,000 request bytes, including whitespace). Returns its txid as plain text. No responses are cached. Cancellation or a transport error after dispatch may leave the submission outcome unknown; do not automatically retry. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#post-transaction)*

Request body: `string` (required)

Returns: text `Txid`

#### GET `/api/tx/{txid}`

Transaction information

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)

Returns: JSON `Transaction`

#### GET `/api/tx/{txid}/hex`

Transaction hex

Hex-encoded serialized transaction. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-hex)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)

Returns: text `Hex`

#### GET `/api/tx/{txid}/merkle-proof`

Transaction merkle proof

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-merkle-proof)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)

Returns: JSON `MerkleProof`

#### GET `/api/tx/{txid}/merkleblock-proof`

Transaction merkleblock proof

Get the merkleblock proof for a transaction (BIP37 format, hex encoded). *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-merkleblock-proof)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)

Returns: text `Hex`

#### GET `/api/tx/{txid}/outspend/{vout}`

Output spend status

Whether the output has been spent and, if so, the spending transaction details. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-outspend)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)
- `vout` (path, Vout, required): Output index

Returns: JSON `TxOutspend`

#### GET `/api/tx/{txid}/outspends`

All output spend statuses

Spend statuses in output-index order. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-outspends)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)

Returns: JSON `TxOutspend[]`

#### GET `/api/tx/{txid}/raw`

Transaction raw

Returns a transaction as binary data. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-raw)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)

Returns: binary data

#### GET `/api/tx/{txid}/status`

Transaction status

Retrieve the confirmation status of a transaction. Returns whether the transaction is confirmed and, if so, the block height, hash, and timestamp. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-status)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)

Returns: JSON `TxStatus`

#### GET `/api/v1/tx/{txid}/rbf`

RBF replacement history

Returns the RBF replacement tree for a transaction, if any. Both `replacements` and `replaces` are null when the tx has no known RBF history within the mempool monitor's retention window. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-rbf-history)*

Parameters:
- `txid` (path, Txid, required)

Returns: JSON `RbfResponse`

### Tx Index

#### GET `/api/tx-index/{index}`

Txid by index

Retrieve the transaction ID (txid) at a given global transaction index. Returns the txid as plain text.

Parameters:
- `index` (path, TxIndex, required): Global transaction index across the chain

Returns: text `Txid`

### Urpd

#### GET `/api/urpd`

Available URPD cohorts

Cohorts for which URPD data is available. Returns names like `all`, `sth`, `lth`, `under_4m`, `under_6m`, `over_4m`, `over_6m`, `utxos_under_1h_old`.

Returns: JSON `Cohort[]`

#### GET `/api/urpd/{cohort}`

Latest URPD

URPD for the latest published block; `date` echoes the date served. Fields, units, price-grid rounding and weighting as in `GET /api/urpd/{cohort}/{point}`.

Parameters:
- `cohort` (path, Cohort, required)
- `agg` (query, UrpdAggregation, optional): Aggregation strategy. Default: raw (no aggregation). Accepts `bucket` as alias.
- `weight` (query, UrpdWeight, optional): Supply weighting. Default: raw (unweighted).

Returns: JSON `Urpd`

#### GET `/api/urpd/{cohort}/{point}`

URPD at block height or date

URPD for a cohort at a block height or the last block of a UTC day. Returns `{ height, hash, date, cohort, weight, aggregation, close, supply, buckets }` where `buckets` is columns, `{ price, supply, realized_cap, unrealized_pnl }`, one entry per bucket in ascending price: the same block header and columnar layout as `GET /api/utxo-set/{point}`. `close`, `price`, `realized_cap`, and `unrealized_pnl` are USD; `supply` is BTC. `unrealized_pnl` can be negative. Bucket `realized_cap` and `unrealized_pnl` value each coin at its creation price on the price grid (four significant digits of the price in cents, within 0.05% of the exact price), rounded to the cent per bucket, so the buckets need not sum to the realized cap series. With a `cointime` or `coinflow` `weight`, `supply` is the weighted supply (whole satoshis) and the bucket values follow it.

Parameters:
- `cohort` (path, Cohort, required)
- `point` (path, string, required)
- `agg` (query, UrpdAggregation, optional): Aggregation strategy. Default: raw (no aggregation). Accepts `bucket` as alias.
- `weight` (query, UrpdWeight, optional): Supply weighting. Default: raw (unweighted).

Returns: JSON `Urpd`

### Utxo Set

#### GET `/api/utxo-set`

Latest UTXO set

The UTXO set after the latest published block, in the layout of `GET /api/utxo-set/{point}`.

Returns: JSON `UtxoSet`

#### GET `/api/utxo-set/{point}`

UTXO set at block height or date

The UTXO set after a block (`840000`) or after the last published block of a UTC day (`YYYY-MM-DD`), by creation height. Returns `{ height, hash, date, count, supply, origins }`; entry `i` of `origins.count` and `origins.supply` (BTC) is what remains unspent of block `i`'s outputs.

Parameters:
- `point` (path, string, required): Confirmed block height as decimal digits (`840000`) or calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

Returns: JSON `UtxoSet`

#### GET `/api/utxo-set/{point}/diff`

UTXO set changes of a block or date

What a block (`840000`) or a UTC day's published blocks (`YYYY-MM-DD`) changed in the UTXO set. Returns `{ first, last, hash, date, created, spent }`: `created` has one row per block, `spent` one row per creation height, each as columnar `height`, `count` and `supply` (BTC). The set after block `first - 1` plus `created` minus `spent` is the set after block `last`.

Parameters:
- `point` (path, string, required): Confirmed block height as decimal digits (`840000`) or calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

Returns: JSON `UtxoSetDiff`

### Validate Address

#### GET `/api/v1/validate-address/{address}`

Validate address

Validate a Bitcoin address and get information about its type and scriptPubKey. Returns `isvalid: false` with an error message for invalid addresses. *[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-validate)*

Parameters:
- `address` (path, string, required): Bitcoin address to validate (can be any string)

Returns: JSON `AddressValidation`

### Version

#### GET `/version`

API version

Returns: JSON `string`

## Schemas

### `Address`

`string`

### `AddressChainStats`

- `balance`: `Sats` (required) — Current confirmed balance in satoshis
- `funded_txo_count`: `integer` (required) — Total number of transaction outputs that funded this address
- `funded_txo_sum`: `Sats` (required) — Total amount in satoshis received by this address across all funded outputs
- `spent_txo_count`: `integer` (required) — Total number of transaction outputs spent from this address
- `spent_txo_sum`: `Sats` (required) — Total amount in satoshis spent from this address
- `tx_count`: `integer` (required) — Total number of confirmed transactions involving this address
- `type_index`: `TypeIndex | null` — Index of this address within its type on the blockchain, null for an address without confirmed activity
- `realized_price`: `Dollars` (required) — Realized price (average cost basis) in USD

### `AddressHashPrefixMatches`

- `address_type`: `OutputType` (required)
- `prefix`: `string` (required)
- `truncated`: `boolean` (required)
- `addresses`: `Address[]` (required)

### `AddressMempoolStats`

- `balance_delta`: `SatsSigned` (required) — Net pending (unconfirmed) balance change in satoshis; negative when pending spends exceed receipts
- `funded_txo_count`: `integer` (required) — Number of unconfirmed transaction outputs funding this address
- `funded_txo_sum`: `Sats` (required) — Total amount in satoshis being received in unconfirmed transactions
- `spent_txo_count`: `integer` (required) — Number of unconfirmed transaction inputs spending from this address
- `spent_txo_sum`: `Sats` (required) — Total amount in satoshis being spent in unconfirmed transactions
- `tx_count`: `integer` (required) — Number of unconfirmed transactions involving this address

### `AddressStats`

- `address`: `Address` (required) — Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output
- `address_type`: `OutputType` (required) — Output script type
- `chain_stats`: `AddressChainStats` (required) — Statistics for confirmed transactions on the blockchain
- `mempool_stats`: `AddressMempoolStats` (required) — Statistics for unconfirmed transactions in the mempool
- `balance`: `Sats` (required) — Total current balance in satoshis, including pending (unconfirmed) mempool changes

### `AddressValidation`

- `isvalid`: `boolean` (required)
- `address`: `string | null` — The validated address
- `scriptPubKey`: `string | null` — The scriptPubKey in hex
- `isscript`: `boolean | null` — Whether the address is P2SH, P2WSH or P2TR
- `iswitness`: `boolean | null`
- `witness_version`: `integer | null` — Witness version (0 for P2WPKH/P2WSH, 1 for P2TR and P2A)
- `witness_program`: `string | null` — Witness program in hex
- `error_locations`: `integer[] | null` — Error locations: an empty array for invalid addresses, omitted for valid ones
- `error`: `string | null` — Error message for invalid addresses

### `Bitcoin`

`number`

### `BlockExtras`

- `totalFees`: `Sats` (required) — Total fees in satoshis
- `medianFee`: `FeeRate` (required) — Median fee rate in sat/vB
- `feeRange`: `FeeRate[]` (required) — Fee rate range: [min, 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 90%, max]
- `reward`: `Sats` (required) — Total block reward (subsidy + fees) in satoshis
- `pool`: `BlockPool` (required)
- `avgFee`: `Sats` (required) — Mean fee per non-coinbase transaction in satoshis, rounded down (0 without any)
- `avgFeeRate`: `FeeRate` (required) — Average fee rate in sat/vB
- `coinbaseRaw`: `string` (required) — Raw coinbase transaction scriptsig as hex
- `coinbaseAddress`: `string | null` — Primary coinbase output address
- `coinbaseAddresses`: `string[]` (required) — All coinbase output addresses
- `coinbaseSignature`: `string` (required) — Coinbase output script in ASM format
- `coinbaseSignatureAscii`: `string` (required) — Coinbase scriptsig with each byte read as the Unicode code point of the same value
- `avgTxSize`: `number` (required) — Non-coinbase transaction bytes over the transaction count (coinbase included), rounded to 2 decimals
- `totalInputs`: `integer` (required) — Total number of inputs (excluding coinbase)
- `totalOutputs`: `integer` (required)
- `totalOutputAmt`: `Sats` (required) — Total output amount in satoshis, coinbase excluded
- `medianFeeAmt`: `Sats` (required) — Median fee amount in satoshis
- `feePercentiles`: `Sats[]` (required) — Fee amount percentiles in satoshis: [min, 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 90%, max]
- `segwitTotalTxs`: `integer` (required)
- `segwitTotalSize`: `integer` (required) — Total size of segwit transactions in bytes
- `segwitTotalWeight`: `Weight` (required)
- `header`: `string` (required) — Raw 80-byte block header as hex
- `utxoSetChange`: `integer` (required) — UTXO set change as mempool.space and bitcoin-cli report it: total outputs minus total inputs, unspendable outputs (OP_RETURN) included, unlike `utxoSetSize`
- `utxoSetSize`: `integer` (required) — Total spendable UTXO set size at this height (excludes OP_RETURN and other unspendable outputs)
- `totalInputAmt`: `Sats` (required) — Total input amount in satoshis
- `virtualSize`: `number` (required) — Virtual size in vbytes: weight / 4, unrounded
- `firstSeen`: `integer | null` — Timestamp when the block was first seen (always null, not yet supported)
- `orphans`: `string[]` (required) — Orphaned blocks (always empty)
- `price`: `Dollars` (required) — USD price at block height

### `BlockFeeRatesEntry`

- `avgHeight`: `Height` (required) — Average block height in this bucket
- `timestamp`: `Timestamp` (required) — Average block timestamp in this bucket
- `avgFee_0`: `FeeRate` (required) — Mean of the blocks' minimum fee rate (sat/vB)
- `avgFee_10`: `FeeRate` (required) — Mean of the blocks' 10th percentile fee rate (sat/vB)
- `avgFee_25`: `FeeRate` (required) — Mean of the blocks' 25th percentile fee rate (sat/vB)
- `avgFee_50`: `FeeRate` (required) — Mean of the blocks' median fee rate (sat/vB)
- `avgFee_75`: `FeeRate` (required) — Mean of the blocks' 75th percentile fee rate (sat/vB)
- `avgFee_90`: `FeeRate` (required) — Mean of the blocks' 90th percentile fee rate (sat/vB)
- `avgFee_100`: `FeeRate` (required) — Mean of the blocks' maximum fee rate (sat/vB)

### `BlockFeesEntry`

- `avgHeight`: `Height` (required) — Average block height in this bucket
- `timestamp`: `Timestamp` (required) — Average block timestamp in this bucket
- `avgFees`: `Sats` (required) — Mean fees per block in this bucket, rounded half up (sats)
- `USD`: `Dollars` (required) — Mean BTC/USD spot price over the bucket's blocks (the price, not the fees in USD)

### `BlockHash`

`string`

### `BlockInfo`

- `id`: `BlockHash` (required) — Block hash
- `height`: `Height` (required)
- `version`: `integer` (required)
- `timestamp`: `Timestamp` (required) — Block timestamp (Unix time)
- `bits`: `integer` (required) — Compact target (bits)
- `nonce`: `integer` (required)
- `difficulty`: `number` (required)
- `merkle_root`: `string` (required)
- `tx_count`: `integer` (required)
- `size`: `integer` (required) — Block size in bytes
- `weight`: `Weight` (required) — Block weight in weight units
- `previousblockhash`: `BlockHash` (required)
- `mediantime`: `Timestamp` (required) — Median time of the last 11 blocks

### `BlockInfoV1`

- `id`: `BlockHash` (required) — Block hash
- `height`: `Height` (required)
- `version`: `integer` (required)
- `timestamp`: `Timestamp` (required) — Block timestamp (Unix time)
- `bits`: `integer` (required) — Compact target (bits)
- `nonce`: `integer` (required)
- `difficulty`: `number` (required)
- `merkle_root`: `string` (required)
- `tx_count`: `integer` (required)
- `size`: `integer` (required) — Block size in bytes
- `weight`: `Weight` (required) — Block weight in weight units
- `previousblockhash`: `BlockHash` (required)
- `mediantime`: `Timestamp` (required) — Median time of the last 11 blocks
- `stale`: `boolean` — Whether this block has been replaced by a longer chain
- `extras`: `BlockExtras` (required)

### `BlockPool`

- `id`: `integer` (required) — Zero-based pool ID, matching mempool.space's `unique_id`
- `name`: `string` (required)
- `slug`: `PoolSlug` (required) — URL-friendly pool identifier
- `blockNumber`: `integer` (required) — This block's ordinal among blocks attributed to this pool
- `minerNames`: `string[] | null` — Miner name tags found in coinbase scriptsig

### `BlockRewardsEntry`

- `avgHeight`: `Height` (required) — Average block height in this bucket
- `timestamp`: `Timestamp` (required) — Average block timestamp in this bucket
- `avgRewards`: `Sats` (required) — Mean coinbase reward (subsidy + fees) per block in this bucket, rounded half up (sats)
- `USD`: `Dollars` (required) — Mean BTC/USD spot price over the bucket's blocks (the price, not the rewards in USD)

### `BlockSizeEntry`

- `avgHeight`: `Height` (required) — Average block height in this bucket
- `timestamp`: `Timestamp` (required) — Average block timestamp in this bucket
- `avgSize`: `integer` (required) — Mean block size in this bucket, rounded half up (bytes)

### `BlockSizesWeights`

- `sizes`: `BlockSizeEntry[]` (required)
- `weights`: `BlockWeightEntry[]` (required)

### `BlockStatus`

- `in_best_chain`: `boolean` (required)
- `height`: `Height | null` — Block height (only if in best chain)
- `next_best`: `BlockHash | null` — Hash of the next block in the best chain (null if tip)

### `BlockTemplate`

- `hash`: `NextBlockHash` (required) — Pass to `GET /api/v1/mempool/block-template/diff/{hash}` to fetch deltas.
- `stats`: `MempoolBlock` (required)
- `transactions`: `Transaction[]` (required) — Full transaction bodies in `getblocktemplate` order.

### `BlockTemplateDiff`

- `hash`: `NextBlockHash` (required) — Current next-block hash. Use as `since` on the next diff call.
- `since`: `NextBlockHash` (required) — Echoed prior hash the diff was computed against.
- `stats`: `MempoolBlock` (required) — Stats of the new template; they can change while every transaction is retained.
- `order`: `BlockTemplateDiffEntry[]` (required) — New template in order. Each entry is either an index into the prior template's transactions or a full transaction body.
- `removed`: `Txid[]` (required) — Txids that left the projected next block since `since` (confirmed, evicted, replaced, or pushed past block 0).

### `BlockTemplateDiffEntry`

`integer | Transaction`

### `BlockTimestamp`

- `height`: `Height` (required)
- `hash`: `BlockHash` (required)
- `timestamp`: `string` (required) — Block timestamp in ISO 8601 format

### `BlockTxIndex`

`integer`

### `BlockWeightEntry`

- `avgHeight`: `Height` (required) — Average block height in this bucket
- `timestamp`: `Timestamp` (required) — Average block timestamp in this bucket
- `avgWeight`: `Weight` (required) — Mean block weight in this bucket, rounded half up (weight units)

### `Cohort`

`string`

### `CpfpCluster`

- `txs`: `CpfpClusterTx[]` (required) — All txs in the cluster, in topological order (parents before children).
- `chunks`: `CpfpClusterChunk[]` (required) — Chunks ordered by descending feerate.
- `chunkIndex`: `integer` (required) — Index into `chunks` of the chunk containing the seed tx.

### `CpfpClusterChunk`

- `txs`: `CpfpClusterTxIndex[]` (required)
- `feerate`: `FeeRate` (required)

### `CpfpClusterTx`

- `txid`: `Txid` (required)
- `weight`: `Weight` (required)
- `fee`: `Sats` (required)
- `parents`: `CpfpClusterTxIndex[]` (required) — In-cluster parents of this tx.

### `CpfpClusterTxIndex`

`integer`

### `CpfpEntry`

- `txid`: `Txid` (required)
- `weight`: `Weight` (required)
- `fee`: `Sats` (required)

### `CpfpInfo`

- `ancestors`: `CpfpEntry[]` (required)
- `bestDescendant`: `CpfpEntry | null` — Best (highest fee rate) descendant, if any.
- `descendants`: `CpfpEntry[]` (required)
- `effectiveFeePerVsize`: `FeeRate` (required) — Effective fee rate considering CPFP relationships (sat/vB). This is the seed's chunk feerate after lift-merging, i.e. the rate Core/mempool.space would surface for this tx.
- `sigops`: `SigOps` (required) — BIP-141 sigop cost for the seed tx (witness sigops count as 1, legacy and P2SH-redeem sigops count as 4).
- `fee`: `Sats` (required) — Transaction fee (sats).
- `vsize`: `VSize` (required) — Virtual size of the seed tx (vbytes).
- `adjustedVsize`: `VSize` (required) — Policy-adjusted virtual size: `max(vsize, sigops * 5)`.
- `cluster`: `CpfpCluster | null` — Cluster the seed belongs to; omitted when the seed has no ancestors and no descendants (matches mempool.space).

### `Currency`

`USD`

### `Date`

`string`

### `DetailedSeriesCount`

- `distinct`: `integer` (required) — Number of unique series available (e.g., realized_price, market_cap)
- `total`: `integer` (required) — Total number of series-index combinations across all timeframes
- `lazy`: `integer` (required) — Number of lazy (computed on-the-fly) series-index combinations
- `stored`: `integer` (required) — Number of eager (stored on disk) series-index combinations
- `by_db`: `object` (required)

### `DifficultyAdjustment`

- `progressPercent`: `number` (required) — Progress through current difficulty epoch (0-100%)
- `difficultyChange`: `number` (required) — Estimated difficulty change at next retarget at the `adjustedTimeAvg` pace (%)
- `estimatedRetargetDate`: `integer` (required) — Estimated timestamp of next retarget (milliseconds)
- `remainingBlocks`: `integer` (required) — Blocks remaining until retarget
- `remainingTime`: `integer` (required) — Estimated time until retarget at `adjustedTimeAvg` (milliseconds)
- `previousRetarget`: `number` (required) — Previous difficulty adjustment (%)
- `previousTime`: `Timestamp` (required) — Timestamp of most recent retarget (seconds)
- `nextRetargetHeight`: `Height` (required)
- `timeAvg`: `integer` (required) — Average block time in current epoch (milliseconds)
- `adjustedTimeAvg`: `integer` (required) — Block time the projection uses (milliseconds): `timeAvg`, except in an epoch's first 503 blocks, where it spans the last 503 blocks, those before the retarget scaled by it
- `timeOffset`: `integer` (required) — Testnet's offset for its 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule (milliseconds): always 0 on mainnet, as mempool.space
- `expectedBlocks`: `number` (required) — Blocks expected at the 10-minute target between the epoch's first block and the tip block

### `DifficultyAdjustmentEntry`

`number[]`

### `DifficultyEntry`

- `time`: `Timestamp` (required) — Unix timestamp of the difficulty adjustment
- `height`: `Height` (required)
- `difficulty`: `number` (required)
- `adjustment`: `number` (required) — Adjustment ratio (new/previous, e.g. 1.068 = +6.8%)

### `DiskUsage`

- `brk`: `string` (required) — Human-readable brk data size (e.g., "48.8 GiB")
- `brk_bytes`: `integer` (required) — brk data size in bytes
- `bitcoin`: `string` (required) — Human-readable Bitcoin blocks directory size
- `bitcoin_bytes`: `integer` (required) — Bitcoin blocks directory size in bytes
- `ratio`: `number` (required) — Ratio of BRK bytes to Bitcoin bytes; zero when Bitcoin bytes are zero.

### `Dollars`

`number`

### `ExchangeRates`

`object`

### `FeeRate`

`number`

### `Format`

`json | csv`

### `HashrateEntry`

- `timestamp`: `Timestamp` (required) — End of the day the hashrate covers (Unix timestamp), as mempool.space stamps it
- `avgHashrate`: `integer` (required) — Average hashrate (H/s)

### `HashrateSummary`

- `hashrates`: `HashrateEntry[]` (required)
- `difficulty`: `DifficultyEntry[]` (required)
- `currentHashrate`: `integer` (required) — Current network hashrate over the trailing 7 days (H/s)
- `currentDifficulty`: `number` (required)

### `Health`

- `status`: `string` (required) — Health status ("healthy")
- `service`: `string` (required)
- `version`: `string` (required)
- `timestamp`: `string` (required) — Current server time (ISO 8601)
- `started_at`: `string` (required) — Server start time (ISO 8601)
- `uptime_seconds`: `integer` (required) — Uptime in seconds
- `indexed_height`: `Height` (required) — Height of the last indexed block
- `computed_height`: `Height` (required) — Height of the last computed block (series)
- `tip_height`: `Height` (required) — Height of the Bitcoin node's chain tip; `/health` reports `indexed_height` instead, without asking the node
- `blocks_behind`: `Height` (required) — Number of blocks behind the tip
- `last_indexed_at`: `string` (required) — Human-readable timestamp of the last indexed block (ISO 8601)
- `last_indexed_at_unix`: `Timestamp` (required) — Unix timestamp of the last indexed block

`minute10 | minute30 | hour1 | hour4 | hour12 | day1 | day3 | week1 | month1 | month3 | month6 | year1 | year10 | halving | epoch | height | tx_index | txin_index | txout_index | empty_output_index | op_return_index | p2a_address_index | p2ms_output_index | p2pk33_address_index | p2pk65_address_index | p2pkh_address_index | p2sh_address_index | p2tr_address_index | p2wpkh_address_index | p2wsh_address_index | unknown_output_index`

### `MempoolBlock`

- `blockSize`: `integer` (required) — Sum of the transactions' serialized sizes in bytes (witness + non-witness), without header or coinbase.
- `blockVSize`: `number` (required) — Sum of the transactions' virtual sizes in vbytes
- `nTx`: `integer` (required) — Number of transactions in the projected block
- `totalFees`: `Sats` (required) — Total fees in satoshis
- `medianFee`: `FeeRate` (required) — Median fee rate in sat/vB
- `feeRange`: `FeeRate[]` (required) — Vsize-weighted percentiles of the transactions' CPFP chunk fee rates, in sat/vB: [0, 10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 100] for the first block, [5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 95] for the later projected ones

### `MempoolInfo`

- `count`: `integer` (required) — Number of transactions in the mempool
- `vsize`: `VSize` (required) — Total virtual size of all transactions in the mempool (vbytes)
- `total_fee`: `Sats` (required) — Total fees of all transactions in the mempool (satoshis)
- `fee_histogram`: `number[][]` (required) — Fee histogram as Esplora bins it: `[[fee_rate, vsize], ...]` by descending fee rate, each entry the vsize of the transactions paying from its fee rate up to the previous entry's, a bin closing at the first fee rate change past 50,000 vB

- `value`: `Sats` (required) — Total output value (sats)

### `PoolStats`

- `poolId`: `integer` (required) — One-based pool ID, matching mempool.space's `id`
- `name`: `string` (required)
- `link`: `string` (required) — Pool website URL
- `blockCount`: `integer` (required)
- `rank`: `integer` (required) — Pool ranking by block count (1 = most blocks)
- `emptyBlocks`: `integer` (required) — Number of empty (coinbase-only) blocks mined in the time period
- `slug`: `PoolSlug` (required) — URL-friendly pool identifier
- `share`: `number` (required) — Pool's share of total blocks (0.0 - 1.0)
- `poolUniqueId`: `integer` (required) — Zero-based pool ID, matching mempool.space's `unique_id`

### `PoolsSummary`

- `pools`: `PoolStats[]` (required) — List of pools sorted by block count descending
- `blockCount`: `integer` (required) — Total blocks in the time period
- `lastEstimatedHashrate`: `integer` (required) — Estimated network hashrate (H/s)
- `lastEstimatedHashrate3d`: `integer` (required) — Estimated network hashrate over last 3 days (H/s)
- `lastEstimatedHashrate1w`: `integer` (required) — Estimated network hashrate over last 1 week (H/s)

### `PreciseRecommendedFees`

- `fastestFee`: `FeeRate` (required) — Fee rate for fastest confirmation (next block)
- `halfHourFee`: `FeeRate` (required) — Fee rate for confirmation within ~30 minutes (second projected block)
- `hourFee`: `FeeRate` (required) — Fee rate for confirmation within ~1 hour (third projected block)
- `economyFee`: `FeeRate` (required) — Smoothed, fullness-adjusted third-block fee estimate, bounded by `minimumFee` and twice it; `minimumFee` when no third projected block exists
- `minimumFee`: `FeeRate` (required) — The node's current mempool minimum fee rate, rounded up to 0.001 sat/vB (at least 0.001)

### `PricePoint`

- `time`: `Timestamp` (required) — Unix timestamp
- `USD`: `Dollars` (required) — BTC/USD price

### `RangeIndex`

`integer | string | string`

### `RawLockTime`

`integer`

### `RbfResponse`

- `replacements`: `ReplacementNode | null`
- `replaces`: `Txid[] | null`

### `RbfTx`

- `txid`: `Txid` (required)
- `fee`: `Sats` (required)
- `vsize`: `VSize` (required)
- `value`: `Sats` (required) — Sum of output amounts.
- `rate`: `FeeRate` (required)
- `time`: `Timestamp` (required)
- `rbf`: `boolean` (required) — BIP-125 signaling: at least one input has sequence < 0xffffffff-1.
- `fullRbf`: `boolean | null` — Only populated on the root `tx` of an RBF response. `true` iff this tx displaced at least one non-signaling predecessor.

### `RecommendedFees`

- `fastestFee`: `integer` (required) — Fee rate for fastest confirmation (next block)
- `halfHourFee`: `integer` (required) — Fee rate for confirmation within ~30 minutes (second projected block)
- `hourFee`: `integer` (required) — Fee rate for confirmation within ~1 hour (third projected block)
- `economyFee`: `integer` (required) — Smoothed, fullness-adjusted third-block fee estimate, bounded by `minimumFee` and twice it; `minimumFee` when no third projected block exists
- `minimumFee`: `integer` (required) — The node's current mempool minimum fee rate, rounded up to a whole sat/vB (at least 1)

### `ReplacementNode`

- `tx`: `RbfTx` (required)
- `time`: `Timestamp` (required) — First-seen timestamp, duplicated here to match mempool.space's on-the-wire shape.
- `fullRbf`: `boolean` (required) — Any predecessor in this subtree was non-signaling.
- `interval`: `integer | null` — Seconds between this node's `time` and the successor that replaced it. Omitted on the root of an RBF response.
- `mined`: `boolean | null` — `Some(true)` iff this node's tx is currently confirmed. Absent on serialization otherwise.
- `replaces`: `ReplacementNode[]` (required)

### `RewardStats`

- `endBlock`: `Height` (required) — Last block in the range
- `totalReward`: `string` (required) — Total coinbase rewards (subsidy + fees) in sats
- `totalFee`: `string` (required) — Total transaction fees in sats
- `totalTx`: `string` (required)

### `SeriesData`

- `index`: `Index` (required)

- `end`: `integer` (required) — End index (exclusive) of the returned range
- `data`: `value[]` (required) — The series data. A value is `null` where it is missing (a period without blocks) or undefined (e.g. NaN, a ratio over zero); CSV leaves such a cell empty.

### `SeriesInfo`

- `nullable`: `Index[]` (required) — Indexes whose values can be null: a missing value (e.g. a period without blocks) or an undefined one (e.g. NaN)
- `type`: `string` (required) — Value type (e.g. "Ratio", "Sats", "Cents")
- `unit`: `string | null` — What the value type measures, when documented (e.g. "A duration in days.")

### `SeriesLeafWithSchema`

- `description`: `string | null` — Human-readable metric definition, when documented.
- `type`: `string` (required) — JSON Schema type (e.g., "integer", "number", "string", "boolean", "array", "object").

### `Transaction`

- `index`: `TxIndex | null` — Internal transaction index (brk-specific, not in mempool.space)
- `txid`: `Txid` (required)
- `version`: `TxVersionRaw` (required) — Transaction version (raw i32 from Bitcoin protocol, may contain non-standard values in coinbase txs)
- `locktime`: `RawLockTime` (required)
- `vin`: `TxIn[]` (required) — Transaction inputs
- `vout`: `TxOut[]` (required) — Transaction outputs
- `size`: `integer` (required) — Transaction size in bytes
- `weight`: `Weight` (required)
- `sigops`: `SigOps` (required) — BIP-141 signature-operation cost
- `fee`: `Sats` (required) — Transaction fee in satoshis
- `status`: `TxStatus` (required)

### `TreeNode`

`object | SeriesLeafWithSchema`

### `TxIn`

- `txid`: `Txid` (required) — Transaction ID of the output being spent
- `vout`: `Vout` (required) — Output index being spent (coinbase: 4294967295)
- `prevout`: `TxOut | null` (required) — The output being spent
- `scriptsig`: `string` (required) — Signature script in hex (empty for native SegWit inputs)
- `scriptsig_asm`: `string` (required) — Signature script in assembly format
- `witness`: `string[]` — Witness data (stack items, present for SegWit inputs; hex-encoded on the wire)
- `is_coinbase`: `boolean` (required)
- `sequence`: `integer` (required)
- `inner_redeemscript_asm`: `string` — Inner redeemscript in assembly (P2SH inputs)
- `inner_witnessscript_asm`: `string` — Inner witnessscript in assembly (P2WSH and P2SH-P2WSH: the witness script; P2TR script path: the leaf script)

### `TxIndex`

`integer`

### `TxOut`

- `scriptpubkey`: `string` (required) — Script pubkey (locking script), encoded as hexadecimal.
- `scriptpubkey_asm`: `string` (required) — Script pubkey in assembly format.
- `scriptpubkey_type`: `OutputTypeNormalized` (required) — Esplora/mempool.space script type.
- `scriptpubkey_address`: `Address` — Bitcoin address, omitted for scripts without an address (P2PK included, as Esplora).
- `value`: `Sats` (required) — Value of the output in satoshis.

### `TxOutspend`

- `spent`: `boolean` (required)
- `txid`: `Txid | null` — Transaction ID of the spending transaction (only present if spent)
- `vin`: `Vin | null` — Input index in the spending transaction (only present if spent)
- `status`: `TxStatus | null` — Status of the spending transaction (only present if spent)

### `TxStatus`

- `confirmed`: `boolean` (required)
- `block_height`: `Height | null` — Block height (only present if confirmed)
- `block_hash`: `BlockHash | null` — Block hash (only present if confirmed)
- `block_time`: `Timestamp | null` — Block timestamp (only present if confirmed)

### `TxVersionRaw`

`integer`

### `Txid`

`string`

### `TypeIndex`

`integer`

### `Urpd`

- `height`: `Height` (required) — Exact published block represented by this distribution.
- `hash`: `BlockHash` (required) — Hash of block `height`.
- `date`: `Date` (required) — UTC date of the represented block's monotonic timestamp.
- `cohort`: `Cohort` (required)
- `weight`: `UrpdWeight` (required)
- `aggregation`: `UrpdAggregation` (required)
- `close`: `Dollars` (required) — Price at `height`, in USD. Anchor for `unrealized_pnl`.
- `supply`: `Bitcoin` (required) — Sum of `buckets.supply`, in BTC.
- `buckets`: `UrpdBuckets` (required)

### `UrpdAggregation`

`raw | lin200 | lin500 | lin1000 | log10 | log50 | log100 | log200 | log500 | log1000 | log2000`

### `UrpdBuckets`

- `price`: `Dollars[]` (required) — Each bucket's price, in USD: its lower bound when aggregated, and for `raw` the price its coins' creation prices round to (four significant digits of the price in cents).
- `supply`: `Bitcoin[]` (required) — Supply held with a last-move price inside each bucket, in BTC. With a `cointime` or `coinflow` weight, the weighted supply, floored to whole satoshis at each grid price.
- `realized_cap`: `Dollars[]` (required) — Realized cap contribution in USD: `price * supply` summed over the coins in each bucket, each coin's creation price taken on the price grid (the `raw` bucket price, within 0.05% of the exact price), rounded to the cent: a bucket worth under half a cent shows 0. The buckets therefore need not sum to the cohort's realized cap series.
- `unrealized_pnl`: `Dollars[]` (required) — Unrealized P&L in USD at the represented block: `close * supply` minus each bucket's grid capital, rounded to the cent once. Can be negative.

### `UrpdWeight`

`raw | cointime | coinflow`

### `Utxo`

- `txid`: `Txid` (required)
- `vout`: `Vout` (required)
- `status`: `TxStatus` (required)
- `value`: `Sats` (required) — Output value in satoshis

### `UtxoChanges`

- `height`: `Height[]` (required) — Creation height of each row.
- `count`: `integer[]` (required) — Number of outputs in each row.
- `supply`: `Bitcoin[]` (required) — BTC held by the outputs in each row.

### `UtxoOrigins`

- `count`: `integer[]` (required) — Number of unspent outputs per creation height.
- `supply`: `Bitcoin[]` (required) — BTC held by the unspent outputs per creation height.

### `UtxoSet`

- `height`: `Height` (required)
- `hash`: `BlockHash` (required)
- `date`: `Date` (required) — UTC date of the represented block's monotonic timestamp (the running maximum of block times).
- `count`: `integer` (required) — Number of unspent outputs.
- `supply`: `Bitcoin` (required) — BTC held by the unspent outputs.
- `origins`: `UtxoOrigins` (required) — Unspent outputs by creation height: entry `i` is what remains of block `i`'s outputs.

### `UtxoSetDiff`

- `first`: `Height` (required) — First block of the diff; it applies to the set after block `first - 1` (the empty set for block 0).
- `last`: `Height` (required) — Last block of the diff, described by `hash` and `date`.
- `hash`: `BlockHash` (required) — Hash of block `last`.
- `date`: `Date` (required) — UTC date of block `last`'s monotonic timestamp.
- `created`: `UtxoChanges` (required) — Outputs created, one row per block, including those spent again within the range (which `spent` lists too).
- `spent`: `UtxoChanges` (required) — Outputs removed, one row per creation height in ascending order: spent outputs, plus the coinbase outputs of blocks 91812 and 91722, which duplicates at 91842 and 91880 overwrote.

### `VSize`

`integer`

### `Version`

`integer`

### `Vin`

`integer`

### `Vout`

`integer`

### `Weight`

`integer`
